_comment: Chapter 4 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the archer scout at home (hub_archer): Grey Mask at night with a child's wooden horse.

text.zh_TW: 斥候：「灰面的事，你想知道多少？」
text.en: Scout: "How much do you want to know about Grey Mask?"

text.zh_TW: 斥候：「往上，軍營。他每晚都一個人坐著，看一個小木馬——小孩玩的那種。很奇怪吧？」
text.en: Scout: "Up, to the barracks. Every night he sits alone looking at a little wooden horse. A child's toy. Strange, right?"
